email_body:
Dear EFIC Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications and Advocacy Trainee position at the European Pain Federation. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web management, and a strong interest in EU affairs and the non-profit sector, I am eager to contribute to EFIC's communications and advocacy work.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I manage WordPress websites, create SEO content, and use tools like Mailchimp and HubSpot for email marketing and CRM. I have experience drafting social media posts, running mailings, and ensuring brand consistency across channels. My technical skills in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript allow me to support visual asset production and website updates efficiently.

I am particularly drawn to EFIC's mission to improve pain care through education and advocacy. I follow EU legislative processes with interest and have supported advocacy projects through content creation and stakeholder communication. I am organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working under pressure, and I thrive in collaborative environments.

I am available to start on 1 February 2027 and have the legal right to work in the EU. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to contribute to your team.

Sincerely,

cover_letter:
Dear EFIC Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Communications and Advocacy Trainee position at the European Pain Federation. With a solid foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and web management, combined with a keen interest in EU affairs and the non-profit sector, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to EFIC's mission of improving pain care and pain science across Europe.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in implementing communications strategies across various channels. I manage WordPress websites, create SEO-optimised content, and use tools such as Mailchimp and HubSpot for email marketing and CRM management. I have drafted social media posts for platforms like LinkedIn and Instagram, run mailings, and ensured brand consistency in all visual assets. My technical skills in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript enable me to support website updates and visual asset production efficiently.

I am particularly drawn to EFIC's advocacy work, including the Societal Impact of Pain platform and EU-level policy engagement. I follow EU legislative processes with great interest and have supported advocacy projects through content creation and stakeholder communication. My experience in managing client websites, such as a pharmacists' association site with ~600 member profiles, has honed my organisational skills and attention to detail. I am comfortable working under time pressure and collaborating with diverse teams.

I am eager to learn from EFIC's experienced team and to develop my skills in communications planning, advocacy, and association management. I am available to start on 1 February 2027 and have the legal right to work in the EU. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
